description: Add stage tracking and narrow loop prevention for target placement tasks.

actions.code:
def hook(ctx, nb):
    nb['stage'] = 'find_target'
    nb['last_hint'] = ''
    nb['placed_count'] = 0
    nb['placed_locations'] = []
    nb['placed_items'] = []
    text = 'Follow ALFWorld order: find the requested object type, take it, do any required clean/heat/cool step, then put it only in/on the requested destination. For two-object tasks, leave placed items and fetch another target of the same type.'
    return {'skills': [{'text': text}], 'tool_hint': 'Do not put a target on a non-destination surface, and do not take back an item after placing it.'}
